# Display snippets for docs/http.md

--8<-- [start:simple_request_examples]
get("http://example.com", BODY)

get("http://api.example.com/data",
    {"Authorization": "Bearer TOKEN"},
    BODY)

post("http://example.com/submit", "key=value", RESPONSE)
--8<-- [end:simple_request_examples]

--8<-- [start:general_request_example]
request({"url": "http://example.com", "method": "HEAD"}, STATUS, BODY)
--8<-- [end:general_request_example]

--8<-- [start:json_request_examples]
json_get("http://api.example.com/users/1", USER),
py.json.get(USER, "name", NAME)

json_post("http://api.example.com/items",
         {"name": "Widget", "price": 9.99},
         RESPONSE)
--8<-- [end:json_request_examples]

--8<-- [start:url_encode_examples]
encode("hello world", E)   # E = "hello%20world"
decode("hello%20world", S) # S = "hello world"
--8<-- [end:url_encode_examples]

--8<-- [start:url_parse_examples]
parse("https://example.com:8080/path?q=1#frag", PARTS)
# PARTS = {scheme: "https", host: "example.com", port: 8080,
#          path: "/path", query: "q=1", fragment: "frag"}   # atom keys

join({scheme: "https", host: "example.com", path: "/api"}, URL)
# URL = "https://example.com/api"
--8<-- [end:url_parse_examples]

--8<-- [start:build_query_url]
-import_from(py.url, [encode, join])
-import_from(py.http, [json_get])

SearchApi(QUERY, RESULTS) <- (
    encode(QUERY, SAFE_QUERY),
    atom_concat("https://api.example.com/search?q=", SAFE_QUERY, URL),
    json_get(URL, RESULTS)
)
--8<-- [end:build_query_url]

--8<-- [start:health_check]
-import_from(py.http, [request])

HealthCheck(URL) <- (
    request({"url": URL, "timeout": 5}, STATUS, _),
    STATUS == 200
)
--8<-- [end:health_check]
